 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Orlando Magic are on the road Tuesday night as they travel to take on the Sacramento Kings in an interconference matchup.
 Orlando enters Tuesday's game with a 2-7 record after losing on the road in overtime to the Golden State Warriors Saturday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Orlando Magic forward Franz Wagner (22)Nathan Ray Seebeck-Imagn Images
 In Saturday's loss, Franz Wagner led the way for the Magic as he recorded 30 points, six rebounds and 11 assists while Anthony Black added 18 points, eight rebounds, six assists, four steals and three blocks of his own.
 The Magic will try to snap their four-game losing streak Tuesday as they face off against a struggling Kings team on the road.
 Sacramento enters Tuesday's contest with a 1-9 record after losing at home to the Miami Heat Sunday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Sacramento Kings guard Darius Acuff Jr. (5)Dennis Lee-Imagn Images
 Darius Acuff Jr. led the way for the Kings in Sunday's loss as he ended the game with 32 points, five rebounds and 10 assists while Zach LaVine recorded 15 points and four rebounds.
 While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Tuesday night's matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Magic Injury Report: Will Desmond Bane, Jalen Suggs Play?
 Orlando Magic guard Desmond Bane (3)Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images
 The Magic have five players listed on their injury report, though Desmond Bane is not one of them.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Of course, Bane missed Saturday's loss due to an illness but he is off the injury report and will return against the Kings.
 Orlando has ruled out Jalen Suggs due to a right knee contusion and bone bruise as he will miss his seventh consecutive contest, though it appears as though he is nearing a return after recently resuming on-court activities.
 With Suggs still sidelined, Anthony Black and Jase Richardson could both continue to have increased roles.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Jalen Suggs (4)Brian Westerholt-Imagn Images
 The Magic have also ruled out Paolo Banchero (high right ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (left knee injury management), Izaiyah Nelson (left ankle injury recovery) and Noah Penda (partially torn right hamstring).
 Kings Injury Report: Will Domantas Sabonis, Keegan Murray Play?
 Sacramento Kings forward Domantas Sabonis (11)© Ken Blaze-Imagn Images
 The Kings have four players listed on their injury report , including Domantas Sabonis and Keegan Murray.
 Sacramento has listed Sabonis as questionable due to left knee soreness and he is in danger of missing his second consecutive contest.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement If Sabonis is sidelined, Precious Achiuwa and Dylan Cardwell could both be in line for increased roles.
 The Kings have also listed Murray as questionable due to right wrist soreness and he is in danger of missing his first game since returning from an ankle injury in Sunday's loss.
 Sacramento Kings forward Keegan Murray (13)Darren Yamashita-Imagn Images
 Maxime Raynaud has been ruled out due to a right patella subluxation while Ben Simmons will miss the remainder of the season with a torn Achilles.
 Fans can catch Tuesday night's matchup between the Magic and Kings from the Golden 1 Center at 10 p.m. ET.
